label: Brigadeiro
step: cook with cocoa and butter, roll
note: Created in the 1940s to support Brigadier Eduardo Gomes’s 1945 presidential candidacy (Heloísa Nabuco de Oliveira). Eaten with a spoon it is brigadeiro de colher.

about.text: A Brazilian sweet of condensed milk, cocoa powder and butter, cooked to a soft-ball stage, rolled into balls and coated in chocolate sprinkles.

sources.text: The first paragraph of its article, shortened.
The photograph, its author and its licence, from its page.

how.text: The condensed milk mix is cooked, stirred, until it pulls from the pan, cooled, rolled into balls and coated so they do not stick.
